prompt: A natural photo as if taken from a high angle with the latest iPhone. Soft indoor light illuminates the face and hair. It has a slight graininess and appropriate sharpness characteristic of smartphone photos, with focus remaining on the background tiles and joints. Avoid excessive wide-angle distortion, skin-beautifying processing, background blur, or studio-like lighting. Porcelain-like white skin. Large eyes emphasized with dark pupils, reddish-pink eyeshadow, tear-bag makeup, and pink lips. Retain a natural photographic texture on the skin. The camera is located diagonally in front of the face at a higher position, looking down at an angle of about 30-45 degrees. The subject is sitting on the stairs, looking up slightly at the lens. Capture from the top of the head to the waist, with the steps and tiled floor visible in the background.

promptZh: 一张由 最新款 iPhone 从高角度拍摄的自然照片。柔和的室内光线照亮了面部和头发。照片带有智能手机拍摄特有的轻微颗粒感和适度的锐度，焦点保留在背景的瓷砖和接缝上。避免过度广角畸变、美颜处理、背景虚化或影棚级灯光。瓷白肌肤。大眼睛突显深色瞳孔，搭配红粉色眼影、卧蚕妆和粉色嘴唇。保留皮肤自然的摄影质感。相机位于面部斜前方较高位置，以约 30-45 度的角度向下俯拍。主体坐在 楼梯 上，微微抬头看向镜头。画面范围从头顶到腰部，背景可见台阶和瓷砖地面。
